# Berg Advisors

> > Berg Advisors is a fully virtual CPA firm founded more than 30 years ago and led by Managing Partner Andrew C. Berg, CPA. The firm serves multi-channel e-commerce sellers, property management companies, and family offices nationwide, delivering outsourced accounting, tax, and advisory services for a flat monthly fee. Berg Advisors differentiates itself through proactive, relationship-driven communication, deep expertise in e-commerce accrual accounting, inventory, and multi-state sales tax nexus, and a mutual success plan built around each client's growth — rather than once-a-year compliance service.
